about: The Data Hub item collection audit rules. scripts/datahub_collection_audit.py reads this file, so change a threshold, word list or owner here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/checks.md says what each check means.

owners.feed: Whoever sends the data (the feed or integration team)
owners.config: The Data Hub administrator for this workspace
owners.pipeline: The Data Hub administrator; Bloomreach support if a job keeps failing
owners.downstream: The Engagement or Discovery owner who uses the catalog

notes.required_min_fill: An identifier or a field the configuration marks required, filled on fewer than this share of sampled records, is high.
notes.key_min_fill: A key_fields field the collection configures or the data contains, filled on fewer than this share of sampled records, is medium.
notes.sparse_fill: A configured attribute filled on fewer than this share of sampled records is low (0 means configured but never filled in the sample: 'unused').
notes.min_sample: Fewer sampled records than this for an item type and its fill rates and type checks are reported as rough, with a not_checked note.
notes.type_mismatch_share: A field whose sampled values (or field-tool examples) disagree with its declared data_type on at least this share of filled values is reported: medium, or high when it is an identifier.
notes.key_fields: Field names that should be filled on every item. Only checked when the collection configures the field or the data contains it somewhere, so a field the collection never uses isn't reported.
notes.type_map: Declared data_type (case-insensitive; 'List.X' is a list) to the JSON value kind it should hold. Numbers sent as text count as a mismatch. Unknown declared types are skipped and listed under not_checked.
notes.record_meta_keys: Record keys that are bookkeeping, not data fields, so they're never counted as unconfigured fields.
notes.pair_tokens: Name parts (split on _ - . and spaces) removed when pairing collections automatically, so products_staging pairs with products_prod. Explicit --pair always wins.
notes.locale_pattern: A name part matching this regular expression is treated as a locale (en, en_us, de-de) and removed when pairing, so products_en pairs with products_de.
notes.success_states: Data Hub job states (lower-cased) that count as a successful run.
notes.failed_states: Data Hub job states (lower-cased) that count as a failed run. The latest data job failing is high; an earlier failure followed by a success is low.
notes.data_job_types: Job types that write data into a collection. Their latest success sets freshness; other job types (configuration-update, destination syncs) are reported on failure only.
notes.stale_days: A collection whose latest successful data job is older than this many days (against --today) is medium.
notes.list_limit: At most this many names are quoted in one finding.
notes.owners: Who usually fixes each kind of finding; every finding names one of these.
